title: Forty Years of Asking Why

pre.en: When does Margaret say she was wrong about history?
pre.zh: Margaret 说她哪一次在历史上出过错？

intro: 一篇人物小传：Tom 的奶奶 Margaret，在约克教了四十年历史，退休后每周四带人走城墙。小传先给事实，再引她和学生的原话，结尾落在一句俏皮话上。读的时候留意被动的否定和疑问：weren't asked、When was it built?、why wasn't it knocked down?

sentences.en: Margaret Taylor taught history at a girls' school in York from 1965 to 2005.
sentences.zh: Margaret Taylor 从 1965 年到 2005 年在约克一所女子学校教历史。

sentences.en: She's 82 now, and she still can't walk past an old building without going on about it for ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 如今她 82 岁了，路过一栋老房子，还是忍不住要讲上十分钟。

sentences.en: So her family have learned to plan ahead.
sentences.zh: 所以家里人早就学会了提前打算。

sentences.en: If you go shopping with Margaret, add an hour.
sentences.zh: 跟 Margaret 去逛街，得多留一个钟头。

sentences.en: Her students weren't asked to learn lists of dates.
sentences.zh: 她从不让学生背一串串的年份。

sentences.en: Instead, each girl was given a street, and she had to find out about one building on it.
sentences.zh: 她给每个女孩分一条街，让她去调查街上的一栋房子。

sentences.en: When was it built?
sentences.zh: 它是什么时候建的？

sentences.en: Who was it built for?
sentences.zh: 是为谁建的？

sentences.en: And why wasn't it knocked down?
sentences.zh: 为什么没被拆掉？

sentences.en: "Teenagers don't care about kings," she says.
sentences.zh: 「十几岁的孩子才不在乎国王呢，」她说。

sentences.en: "But they do care about who slept in their bedroom in 1820."
sentences.zh: 「可她们很在乎 1820 年谁睡在自己的卧室里。」

sentences.en: Joyce Wood was in her class in 1978.
sentences.zh: Joyce Wood 1978 年在她班上。

sentences.en: "I put off my project for weeks," she says.
sentences.zh: 「我把作业拖了好几个星期，」她说。

sentences.en: "But Mrs Taylor was very patient with me."
sentences.zh: 「可 Taylor 老师对我特别有耐心。」

sentences.en: "And to my surprise, my house turned out to be an old sweet shop."
sentences.zh: 「结果没想到，我家以前居然是一家糖果店。」

sentences.en: "I've taken an interest in old buildings ever since."
sentences.zh: 「从那以后，我就对老房子感兴趣了。」

sentences.en: Margaret knows the city inside out.
sentences.zh: Margaret 对这座城市了如指掌。

sentences.en: And when she talks about it, she really brings it to life.
sentences.zh: 她一讲起来，老城就活了。

sentences.en: Every Thursday, she leads a free walking tour of the city walls for members of the public.
sentences.zh: 每周四，她都为普通游客带一次免费的城墙徒步游。

sentences.en: In fifteen years, more than fifteen thousand people have joined her.
sentences.zh: 十五年来，已经有一万五千多人跟她走过。

sentences.en: On average, about twenty people turn up, even in the rain.
sentences.zh: 平均每次来二十个人左右，下雨也照来不误。

sentences.en: Tours are rarely cancelled at short notice.
sentences.zh: 导览很少临时取消。

sentences.en: And have they ever been cancelled because of the weather?
sentences.zh: 那有没有因为天气取消过呢？

sentences.en: "Never," says Margaret.
sentences.zh: 「从来没有，」Margaret 说。

sentences.en: "This is Yorkshire."
sentences.zh: 「这可是约克郡，下点雨算什么。」

sentences.en: This month, part of the wall is being repaired, so the group's taking a longer route.
sentences.zh: 这个月，有一段城墙正在维修，所以大家得绕远路走。

sentences.en: She's always been passionate about the history of ordinary people.
sentences.zh: 她一直对普通人的历史特别着迷。

sentences.en: "A teacher's job is simple," she says, getting straight to the point.
sentences.zh: 「老师的活儿很简单，」她开门见山地说。

sentences.en: "Make them ask why, and make sure they pass it on."
sentences.zh: 「让学生学会问为什么，还要让他们把这份好奇传下去。」

sentences.en: So, has she ever been wrong about history?
sentences.zh: 那么，她讲历史有没有讲错过？

sentences.en: She thinks for a long time.
sentences.zh: 她想了很久。

sentences.en: "Once. In 1987."
"I'm still not ready to talk about it."
sentences.zh: 「我到现在还不想提。」

cards.note: to talk about something for a long time, often in a way that is boring for other people
cards.tip: 带一点抱怨或调侃；后面接 about：go on about work。和 go on（继续）不是一回事。
cards.example: He keeps going on about his new car.

cards.note: to make plans for something before it happens
to get information about something, often by asking someone or by chance
knock down a wall / a house；也能说「撞倒」：He was knocked down by a bike。
指 13 到 19 岁（thirteen 到 nineteen 都带 teen）的人。
to decide to do something later than planned
cards.tip: 后面接名词或 doing：put off doing sth，不说 put off to do；宾语是代词时放中间：put it off。
cards.example: Stop putting off your dentist appointment.

cards.note: to stay calm and not get angry when someone is slow or makes mistakes
cards.tip: 对人用 with，对事也可以用 with / about；反义词是 impatient。
cards.example: Be patient with him — it's only his second week.

cards.note: used to say that something was not what you expected
to happen in a way you did not expect, or to be discovered to be true
英式说法，sweets 是糖果；美式说 candy store。
to start to be interested in something and want to learn about it
cards.tip: 介词用 in；说「开始感兴趣」这个变化。比较 be interested in（状态）。
cards.example: My son has started to take an interest in cooking.

cards.note: to know everything about something
cards.tip: 东西放在 know 和 inside out 中间；inside out 单独用是「里朝外」：wear a T-shirt inside out。
cards.example: She knows the codebase inside out, so ask her first.

cards.note: to make something more interesting or exciting
cards.tip: 常说讲故事、讲课、表演把东西讲「活」了；不及物的说法是 come to life。
cards.example: Good examples bring a talk to life.

cards.note: 过去式 led；lead a tour 带团参观，lead a team 带团队。
used to say what is usual when you look at many different amounts
cards.tip: 固定说法，不加 the：on average；常放句首，后面加逗号。
cards.example: On average, I get about fifty emails a day.

cards.note: to arrive, often late or when people are not sure you will come
英式拼写双写 l：cancelled、cancelling；美式常写 canceled。
with very little warning or time to prepare
英式读音像 root；bus route 公交线路。
to have very strong feelings of love or interest for something
cards.tip: 介词用 about，后面接名词或 doing：passionate about teaching；比 like 强得多。
cards.example: Our team is passionate about good design.

cards.note: ordinary people 普通人，和国王、名人相对。
to start talking or writing about the most important thing
to give something to another person, for example knowledge or a message
cards.tip: 代词放中间：pass it on；给谁用 to：pass it on to your children。
cards.example: Could you pass this message on to Tom?
